characters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent 2D cutout animation rig sheet.
The attached image is the exact identity and lighting reference for Ember, the left-side king in Fortress AI. Create separated articulation pieces of THIS SAME character, not a redesign: cheerful stocky brown-bearded king, gold crown with red gems, expressive big brown eyes, blue royal tunic with cream cuffs, broad brown belt and square gold buckle, red cloak with gold chain clasps, brown boots. Three-quarter game view looking toward the RIGHT. Bright polished cartoon 3D-painted game art, warm top-left light, crisp clean silhouettes. Match the reference proportions and facial identity exactly.

Create ONE transparent PNG sheet with exactly TWO columns and THREE rows, exactly SIX isolated parts, cell order below. Each part centered inside its own equal-size cell, generous 12% transparent clearance on all four sides. Parts must NOT touch or cross a cell boundary. No dividers, labels, text, background, shadow ground, frame, white rectangle, extra characters.
Row 1 left: full body BASE from empty neck opening down to BOTH complete boots, blue tunic, belt, legs, stationary far arm on the image-right side. REMOVE entire head/crown/beard, REMOVE nearest arm on image-left, REMOVE all red cape. Upper left shoulder socket must be covered by blue cloth so a separate upper arm can overlap. Never cut boots.
Row 1 right: complete HEAD with crown, hair, ears, brown beard, smiling mouth, eyes OPEN, isolated at the neck with a little hidden neck overlap. No torso, no shoulders.
Row 2 left: exactly the SAME HEAD in exactly the same orientation, scale and silhouette, but both eyes gently CLOSED in a natural blink. Crown and beard unchanged, not a sleepy or injured pose.
Row 2 right: isolated nearest FRONT ARM, the image-left arm: rounded blue shoulder and blue upper sleeve, cream cuff, skin hand and all fingers, arm hanging naturally with slight bend. Include rounded upper shoulder overlap, NO torso and NO second arm.
Row 3 left: complete RED CAPE only, including the hidden upper shoulder attachment, flowing downward toward image-left, no chain clasps, no body, no skin. Match the reference cape silhouette and light.
Row 3 right: a small UPPER CHEST overlay only, matching the blue jacket from neck to just ABOVE the belt, including gold chain clasps, no arms, no belt, no head. This is an overlapping breathing layer to be placed on the body's upper torso. Slight rounded shoulder edges, no large protrusions.

Important: these are real detachable pieces for a skeletal puppet. The body MUST be headless and missing the nearest arm and cloak. The two head cells MUST contain only heads and be identically registered. Keep all pieces complete and fully inside their cells. Truly transparent alpha, not a checkerboard painted into the image. No text.

characters.repairPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct this transparent 2-column by 3-row puppet part sheet. Keep every cell and every other asset exactly unchanged, same canvas, character, scale, position and lighting. ONLY change the TOP-LEFT body base: REMOVE the entire near arm on the IMAGE-LEFT side from shoulder to fingertips, including its teal sleeve, silver cuff and hand. Replace that arm's pixels with transparent background. Reconstruct the small left edge of teal tunic behind where the arm had been, with a round shoulder socket at the very top, as the separate arm in middle-right cell will be attached there. Keep BOTH boots, belt, torso and trousers completely intact. The body base must be headless and have NO arm on image-left. Do NOT add a new arm, head, cloak, background, label or text. Preserve all remaining five cells exactly as is. Real transparency everywhere outside the six parts, no glow or cast shadows.

layoutNotes: Generated sheets preserve six distinct parts but row spacing is not an exact equal grid. Importer uses explicit inspected cell rectangles with clear gaps. Never slices equal cells blindly.
